major: MAJOR-E1: _is_challenge_page is not bounded in time. The B4-R2 'bounded regex over text[:65536]' (_V2_TITLE_RE = <title(?:\s[^>]*)?>(.*?)</title\s*>, re.S, .search on html[:65536]) is quadratic: search retries at every '<title' opener and each attempt scans to the end of the window. It runs inline on the event loop in async _extract_from_url_v2, before any offload. Measured in the scratch worktree with a MockTransport serving a crafted 66 KB page ('<title ' x 9400 with no closing tag): the regex alone takes 2497 ms. One link gives a 2463-2468 ms max event-loop gap; a pair gives 5052-5615 ms. This holds in both ENABLE_PRICE_PARSE_OFFLOAD states. The same page on the flag-OFF path gives a 40-53 ms gap. The outcome is a refunded non-delivery (UNRESOLVED_PRODUCT no_product_node), so the free tier does not bound it: any signed-in account can stall the single uvicorn worker about 5 s per call, limited only by @limiter.limit('10/minute') on each verb. This is the event-loop-freeze class that W0-1 and W0-4 removed. It is dark today and goes live on the flip. Fix shape for a ruling: scan only the first opener with a bounded attribute class (re.search(r'<title\b[^>]{0,256}>') plus a bounded str.find for '</title'), or evaluate the check inside the offloaded parse job. Add a PIN row on the probe page (the check and the one-link loop gap under a small bound) and a mutant that restores the current pattern. Evidence: [pyt] tag=b4a2e-probe-title-regex2 elapsed=22s status=OK rc=0.
